en-US.whatsNew:
Deleting albums and folders works again, and you can now drag albums into folders.

• Fixed deleting an album or folder doing nothing
• Drag an album or folder onto a folder to move it there
• Empty albums delete in one tap; albums with photos ask first
• Deleting a folder keeps its albums and moves them up a level
en-US.promotionalText: Free forever. No ads, no subscriptions, no paywall, no limits. Unlimited albums, a different album on every widget, and photos that change on their own all day.
